description: This file defines the 'GenericResultWaiter' class which implements the 'GenericRequester' interface. It manages asynchronous service result handling, allowing waiting for completion, retrieving results, and handling exceptions.

classes.name: GenericResultWaiter
classes.description: Manages asynchronous service result handling, including receipt of results or exceptions, and waiting for completion.

methods.name: receiveResult
methods.description: Handles successful receipt of a result, marks completion, and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: receiveThrowable
methods.description: Handles an exception thrown during service execution, marks completion.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status code of the service.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the service has completed.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the exception if any; throws exception if call not completed.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the result map if completed; throws exception if not completed.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the service to complete with a default timeout.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the service to complete, checking every specified milliseconds.
